name: The Marriage Supper Of The Lamb
overview: The Marriage Supper of the Lamb symbolizes the joyous union between Christ, the Bridegroom, and His prepared bride, the Church, as depicted in Revelation 19:7 where the celebration marks the fulfillment of God's redemptive plan. Jesus, portrayed as the Bridegroom in John 3:29 and Matthew 25:1, calls His followers to readiness and faithfulness as they await His return, promised in John 14:3. This divine marriage feast underscores the ultimate victory and reign of God, celebrated with great rejoicing in Revelation 19:6, highlighting the intimate and eternal fellowship believers will share with Christ.
